items: 【21Pcs Full Pliers Assortment 】Precision-forged pliers set tackle 95% of repair tasks—from automotive repairs and plumbing to electronics and DIY. The complete set eliminates tool hunting with specialized pliers, ideal as Holiday, Fathers' Day Gift

【Package Included】Locking Pliers (7in 10in); Long Nose Locking Plier (6-1/2in); Locking C-Clamp (6in); Groove Joint Pliers(8in 12in); Circlip Pliers (7in x 4pcs); Slip Joint Pliers (6in 8in); Wire Stripper (8in); Multifunctional Linesman Plier(8in); Wire Cutter (8in); Adjustable Oil Filter Plier (12in); Long Nose Plier(6in); Diagonal Pliers ( 4in 6in); Needle Nose Pliers (5in 8in)
【Ergonomic TPR Grip System】TPR handles absorb 70% vibration shock during heavy use. Aggressive texture maintains control in greasy conditions, reducing hand fatigue during extended projects

【Strategic Alloy Deployment】Cr-V Steel Jaws for Extreme Hardness, Carbon Steel Bodies for Impact Absorption. Precision material engineering maximizes durability. Serrated teeth bite through oily pipes and stubborn fasteners without slippage

【10-Second Tool Deployment】 EVA foam slots lock each tool in battle-ready position. Modular trays deploy tools in <10 seconds—no more cluttered workspaces. EVA 3pcs | 14.57x12.6x3.15" (total) | 1.06" each in thick
